run_evaluation: run an evaluation module by name with args and optional resume flag
run_app_evaluation: run an app-prefixed evaluation module by dynamically importing and executing its main function
run_evaluation_resume: run an evaluation module with resume_preempt enabled to continue a previous run
run_eval_with_args: run an evaluation module passing custom argparse-style args to the imported eval main
import_eval_module: dynamically import an eval module from evals namespace or app namespace and call its main
